title: Home tipper axes (Z1/A1 and Z2/A2) using AUTO REF and verify home proximity switch stop
summary: Home all tipper axes so the system can proceed to cycle start. Use AUTO REF to home the left tipper axes (Z1/A1) and right tipper axes (Z2/A2), and verify the axis button state changes green→yellow while moving and that the tipper motor stops after sensing the “home” proximity switch.
when_to_use: Use when the system/operator station needs to home every tipper axis (Z1/A1 left tipper and Z2/A2 right tipper) before pressing CYCLE START.
access_or_tools_needed: Operator station HMI screen showing AUTO REF and axis button indicators

system_preconditions: Verify the main disconnect is ON (if the system has been turned off).
Verify the AGVs are powered on.
external_references: Reference P40A (V2.0) user manual, Document version: V1.1 (20231206) for instructions on starting the AGVs.

visual_references.description: Operator station main screen image showing the CYCLE STOP button and the homing step text (AUTO REF; axis button green→yellow; home proximity switch stop).

steps.title: Identify left and right tipper axis controls (Z1/A1 and Z2/A2) on the operator station
steps.purpose: Ensure you are using the correct axis controls for the left (Z1/A1) and right (Z2/A2) tippers before starting AUTO REF homing.
steps.instruction: At the operator station, identify the axis controls for Z1 and A1 (left tipper) and Z2 and A2 (right tipper) on the operator station HMI.
steps.expected_result: You can clearly locate the axis controls/indicators corresponding to Z1/A1 (left) and Z2/A2 (right) on the operator station HMI.
steps.healthy_condition: Both left and right tipper axis controls/indicators are visible and selectable on the operator station HMI.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot identify the correct axis controls/indicators for Z1/A1 and Z2/A2 on the operator station HMI.

actions.label: Locate axis controls
actions.exact_action: Identify the axis controls for Z1 and A1 (left tipper) and Z2 and A2 (right tipper).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: "Home" every axis: Z1 and A1 (left tipper) and Z2 and A2 (right tipper).

steps.title: Press AUTO REF to home all tipper axes
steps.purpose: Start the automatic referencing (homing) sequence for all tipper axes.
steps.instruction: Press AUTO REF to reference/home every axis (Z1/A1 and Z2/A2).
steps.expected_result: The homing sequence starts for the axes.
steps.healthy_condition: AUTO REF is accepted and the axis button state begins changing as the axes move.
steps.failure_condition: Pressing AUTO REF does not start homing (no axis movement/state change).
stop_or_escalate_if: If axis buttons do not change green→yellow when AUTO REF is pressed, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Press AUTO REF. The axis button changes from green to yellow to indicate it is moving.

steps.title: Verify axis button state changes green→yellow while moving
steps.purpose: Confirm each axis is actively moving during homing.
steps.instruction: Observe each axis button for Z1/A1 and Z2/A2 and confirm the axis button changes from green to yellow to indicate it is moving.
steps.expected_result: Each axis button changes from green to yellow during AUTO REF homing.
steps.healthy_condition: Axis button indicators for the axes you are homing show green→yellow transitions while the axes move.
steps.failure_condition: Axis button indicators do not change green→yellow when AUTO REF is pressed.

actions.label: Check axis button color/state
actions.exact_action: The axis button changes from green to yellow to indicate it is moving.

stop_or_escalate_if: If axis buttons do not change green→yellow when AUTO REF is pressed, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The axis button changes from green to yellow to indicate it is moving.

steps.title: Verify tipper motor stops after sensing the “home” proximity switch
steps.purpose: Confirm the homing stop condition is working (home proximity switch is sensed).
steps.instruction: Watch the tipper motor movement for each side until it senses the “home” proximity switch, then confirm the motor stops.
steps.expected_result: For each axis/side, the tipper motor moves until it senses the “home” proximity switch, then stops.
steps.healthy_condition: Motor motion stops at the home position after sensing the home proximity switch.
steps.failure_condition: The motor does not stop after sensing the “home” proximity switch.

actions.label: Watch for home proximity stop
actions.exact_action: The tipper motor moves until it senses the "home" proximity switch, then stops.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the motor does not stop at the 'home' proximity switch, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The tipper motor moves until it senses the "home" proximity switch, then stops.

steps.title: Confirm homing is complete for both left (Z1/A1) and right (Z2/A2) axes before proceeding
steps.purpose: Ensure the system is ready for the next action (CYCLE START).
steps.instruction: Confirm homing is complete for both left (Z1/A1) and right (Z2/A2) axes before proceeding to cycle start.
steps.expected_result: Both left and right tipper axes have completed homing (no longer moving as part of AUTO REF).
steps.healthy_condition: Homing motion has finished for both sides, indicating the system can proceed.
steps.failure_condition: One or both sides appear not to have completed homing (e.g., still moving or not stopped at home).

actions.label: Verify both sides homed
actions.exact_action: Confirm homing is complete for both left (Z1/A1) and right (Z2/A2) axes before proceeding.

stop_or_escalate_if: If homing is not complete for both left and right axes, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Home every axis... Press CYCLE START. The motor moves from "home" to "ready."

success_criteria: Axis buttons for Z1/A1 and Z2/A2 change from green to yellow while moving during AUTO REF.
Tipper motor movement stops after sensing the “home” proximity switch.
Homing is complete for both left (Z1/A1) and right (Z2/A2) axes before proceeding.
healthy_conditions: Axis button indicators transition green→yellow during homing.
Tipper motor stops at the home proximity switch for both left and right tippers.
failure_conditions: Axis buttons do not change green→yellow when AUTO REF is pressed.
Tipper motor does not stop at the “home” proximity switch.
Homing is not complete for both left (Z1/A1) and right (Z2/A2) axes.
escalation_guidance: Stop and escalate if axis buttons do not change green→yellow when AUTO REF is pressed, or if the motor does not stop at the 'home' proximity switch.
